subject.title: Voice transcript recovery turn generates response but delivery-mirror drops Telegram reply

question: Should this issue remain blocked on live/source reproduction of async Telegram voice transcript recovery delivery, or should maintainers allow a narrow source investigation to create that repro first?
rationale: The report is plausible and high-impact, but current code only proves adjacent transcript and fallback paths; choosing a repair boundary without reproducing the recovery-turn drop risks fixing the wrong Telegram delivery layer.

options.title: Require recovery-turn proof first
options.body: Keep this issue in maintainer/live-repro review until the exact generated-reply drop is reproduced or isolated in source, then queue the narrow fix.

options.title: Promote source-repro investigation
options.body: Allow a repair worker to add a focused failing regression that models voice transcript recovery before making production behavior changes.

options.title: Fold into the message-tool fallback work
options.body: Treat the open message-tool-only fallback PR as canonical only if maintainers confirm the same fallback predicate is the root cause for this voice recovery flow.

recommendation.title: Require recovery-turn proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue in maintainer/live-repro review until the exact generated-reply drop is reproduced or isolated in source, then queue the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checked-out blame points to the central Telegram dispatcher carrier commit, and the choice is about proof sufficiency for that dispatch boundary.
